# Projective Finance

> Projective Finance is a renewable energy lender in the United States. Builders upload project documents to Projective OS, Projective underwrites them against its credit standards, and deals that clear reach terms in 15 to 20 days and close in 3 to 6 weeks. Projective finances up to 100% of construction cost through a first lien senior facility, so builders keep full ownership. Qualified investors worldwide can lend into Projective investment pools.

## What Projective offers

- Development capital, construction loans and permanent debt for solar, battery storage and municipal renewable projects.
- Capital needs from about $500,000 to $25 million and above.
- No upfront equity from the builder. Up to 100% of construction cost financed.
- Multi project pipelines financed through a single vehicle on one ledger: one close, one set of fees.
- Investor CRM on Projective OS: builders manage their investors directly on Projective, with commitments, contact history, documents and distributions beside each deal.
- Loan servicing on Projective OS: every repayment, covenant and report on one ledger, visible to lenders for the life of the loan.
- Interest paid monthly on a fixed schedule.

## For investors

- Open to qualified investors worldwide: individuals, family offices, funds and institutions.
- Open an account from anywhere, fund in any currency, choose a position from development capital to permanent debt.
- Interest monthly or at maturity. Every position recorded on one auditable ledger.
- Availability subject to eligibility and local regulations. Nothing on the site is an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy any security.

## Common questions

### What types of projects does Projective finance?

Projective lends to renewable energy projects in the United States: commercial and community solar, battery storage and municipal projects such as schools. We offer development capital, construction loans and permanent debt, with capital needs from about $500,000 to $25 million.

### What are the sponsor equity requirements?

Often none. For projects with investment-grade municipal or utility offtake, Projective can fund up to 100% of construction cost through a senior first-lien facility. The builder keeps full ownership and the full project economics after debt service. Advance rates depend on offtaker credit, contract structure, and track record.

### How are projects evaluated and underwritten?

Projective OS reads every document, pulls out the terms that matter and tests each one against policy: offtake tenor against loan term, site control, interconnection status and debt service coverage at base and downside cases. An underwriter reviews the result and nothing moves without a human sign off. Every check is written down.

### How are renewable energy incentives incorporated into financing?

Projective packages RECs and state and federal tax credits and sells them through our brokerage partners, so the builder never has to find buyers or manage filings. Every sale complies with the relevant state and federal agencies.

### Why does Projective prioritize municipal-backed projects?

Projects backed by municipal or public offtake carry rated, often state-guaranteed credit. Underwriting against that credit rather than a developer’s balance sheet lets us move faster, offer higher advance rates, and place the paper with institutional lenders more efficiently.
